text:
maya: Quick handoff — I'm swapping with @jon, stepping out after 4pm. Leaving the short notes below.

maya: Canary rollout for model `redwood-3b-v2` started ~15m ago at 5% traffic. Watch gen-service latency and error rate.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started id=c-8790 model=redwood-3b-v2 traffic=5%

jon: Got it — I'll take over watch. Any immediate regressions?

maya: No functional regressions seen in smoke tests. Two hotspots to keep an eye on:
- embedders spike CPU on host `gpu-12` when seq_len > 1024 (seen twice during stress tests)
- cache eviction spike on `/chat` after a burst around 18:40; eviction rate briefly doubled

sam: I alerted infra about `gpu-12` earlier — they plan a driver/firmware patch tomorrow morning. If it spikes, the platform's CPU fallback path is enabled (slower but safe).

maya: Action items:
1) If p99 gen latency > 1.2s for 3 consecutive minutes, trigger rollback: use internal rollback API or run:
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/rollouts/c-8790/rollback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_TOKEN"
```
2) If gen.error_rate > 1% for 5m, page SRE and scale up canary pool.

jon: Also pinged @kelly to add a short-term alert for cache eviction noise.

kelly: On it — adding alert `gen.cache.evictions.rate > 10/min` -> pager. ETA ~10m :white_check_mark:

maya: CR pings: PR #4321 modifies `batcher.py` to tweak max_batch_bytes and TTL. Left one comment about an edge-case for empty input. @jon can you take a look? small change, low-risk.

jon: :eyes: will review in the next 30m, can merge if green.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary metrics (rolling 10m) p50=180ms p95=430ms p99=980ms error_rate=0.2%

jon: Metrics look okay but watching p99 trend. Note: there's a scheduled DB vacuum at 02:00 UTC that might nudge latencies briefly.

maya: Thanks all — handing over to @jon. If anything urgent, ping me on my cell. :phone:

jon: Thanks @maya — taking over. I'll post updates here if I see anything unusual.

sam: FYI left a short runbook note in the handbook about `gpu-12` fallback steps. Link: https://go.redwood/runbooks/gpu-fallback

kelly: Alert added and rules tested. Leaving quiet for now unless thresholds are hit.

jon: Acknowledged. Monitoring dashboard pinned to channel. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
